metaDescription: Line up minute, hour, day, month and weekday fields of crontab entries in columns. Commands and comments stay exactly as written.
intro: Aligns crontab fields into columns so schedules are easy to scan.
why:
Crontab files grow by pasting. Uneven spacing hides which job runs when.

The tool pads the five time fields to a common width, keeps @reboot style lines and variable lines as they are and leaves each command exactly as typed. Turn on the user column for /etc/crontab style files. Lines with too few fields are left alone and listed for review. It does not check the values.
howTo: Tick the user column option for /etc/crontab.
Use the cron explainer to check the schedules.

faq.a: No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
